summary: Gain expertise in ICT infrastructure management with our comprehensive training course. Learn essential skills for effective IT infrastructure management.
lede: ICT infrastructure management connects service practices, governance, security controls, cloud operating models, and real-time monitoring to help teams manage infrastructure with greater clarity. This course shows you how to assess infrastructure health, map service dependencies, interpret monitoring evidence, classify operational risks, and report measurable results. You will build practical artefacts including an infrastructure asset register, service dependency map, availability and capacity indicators, incident escalation workflow, and change risk assessment. The course also introduces SNMP-based monitoring, Wireshark network evidence, virtualization and cloud responsibility models, and the NIST Cybersecurity Framework 2.0, while keeping advanced architecture, automation engineering, and enterprise tool configuration at an introductory or operational level.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who operate, coordinate, secure, or govern ICT infrastructure and need a practical foundation for consistent service delivery. It suits early-career practitioners and experienced specialists moving into broader infrastructure responsibility.
prerequisites: You need general workplace IT experience and comfort reading simple network, asset, or service records. The exercises use structured datasets and templates, so coding is not required. Advanced concepts such as cloud automation and AI-assisted infrastructure analytics are covered at conceptual awareness or operational application level, not technical engineering level.
